sources.title: Rainfall across Singapore
sources.limitations: Station observations can contain gaps and do not represent every point between stations. Preserve station, timestamp, and retrieval provenance.
sources.use_for_training: May seed or validate environmental scenario distributions; it does not supply a system-performance coefficient.

sources.title: Visibility observations
sources.limitations: Spatial and temporal coverage varies by station. Keep the station and observation time and leave unmatched values null.
sources.use_for_training: May support mist scenario labelling or distribution fitting; it does not directly determine track uncertainty.

sources.title: Meteorological observing network
sources.update_frequency: depends on instrument and published product
sources.limitations: Measurements are point observations with instrument-specific sampling and averaging. Retain source-native units and timing metadata.
sources.use_for_training: May inform scenario ranges and replay cases; simulator response remains separately calibrated.

sources.title: Versioned building geometry selected by the project
sources.limitations: No building dataset is bundled here. Geometry, height assumptions, coordinate reference system, and release identity must be supplied and versioned before use.
sources.use_for_training: Compute candidate-local intersections consistently across all candidates and splits.

sources.title: Versioned simulation or test telemetry
sources.publisher: project simulator or approved test harness
sources.limitations: The simulator version, configuration, random seed, and measurement definition must accompany each generated dataset.
sources.use_for_training: Supplies system-specific condition evidence and outcomes; never substitute undocumented constants.

sources.title: Aviation Weather Handbook
sources.limitations: Provides general evidence about precipitation, blockage, and reflection; it is not a calibration source for this simulator.
sources.use_for_training: Justifies representing degraded observations, not any numeric performance multiplier.

sources.title: GPS Accuracy
sources.limitations: Describes blockage and multipath generally and does not specify this project's sensors or geometry.
sources.use_for_training: Supports inclusion of mapped obstruction evidence, not an automatic action label.

sources.title: Measurement Uncertainty
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.limitations: General uncertainty guidance; project-specific probability models still require documented calibration and validation.
sources.use_for_training: Supports retaining distributions and missingness instead of applying unsupported deterministic corrections.

sources.title: Synthetic example weather
sources.limitations: Invented values used only to demonstrate the contract shape.
sources.use_for_training: Do not treat as observed Singapore data.

sources.title: Synthetic example building map
sources.limitations: Invented geometry identifiers used only to demonstrate the contract shape.
sources.use_for_training: Replace with a versioned project geometry source before dataset generation.
